movelist.name: Helping Hand
movelist.effect: Helping Hand grants the target +2 on their next Accuracy Roll this round, and +10 to the next Damage Roll this round.

movelist.name: Razor Leaf
movelist.effect: Razor Leaf is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Sweet Scent
movelist.effect: Targets hit by Sweet Scent gain a -2 Penalty to Evasion. (Total Evasion may not be lowered to a negative value. )

movelist.name: Flail
movelist.effect: For each Injury the user has, Flail’s Damage Base is increased by +1.

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

movelist.name: Absorb
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.effect: While in Sunny Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.effect: The user gains a bonus to Initiative equal to half its Speed, and a +3 Bonus on Save Checks against Sleep.
